summary:
Fixed the stale-read bug.

Changed:
- [app/handler.go](/app/app/handler.go): `/read` now uses `ReadLinearizable` instead of serving directly from local KV state.
- [app/raft/node.go](/app/app/raft/node.go): heartbeat handling now advances the follower commit index from the leader’s commit index, so healed followers apply catch-up entries before linearizable reads return.

Verification:
- Ran `./test.sh`
- Result: `PASS: All rounds passed — reads are linearizable`
